path.description: Source data file (.csv, .json, .xlsx, .xls). It is not changed.

columns.description: Exact names of the columns to replace with pseudonyms (for example the columns holding names, emails or phone numbers).

outputFolder.description: The folder to write the two results into — usually the source file's own folder. The copy is <name>.pseudonymized.<ext> (an .xls source gives .xlsx) and the key is <name>.pseudonymized.key.csv; neither may already exist.
